name: AccessibleIcon
description:
Wrap a decorative SVG/glyph with an accessible label. The icon itself
is marked `aria-hidden`, and the label renders in a `VisuallyHidden` sibling.
The forwarded ref targets the wrapped icon element (typically an `<svg>`),
so consumers can measure or focus-control it through the primitive.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for screen readers.

name: Accordion
description:
Vertical stack of collapsible sections. Controlled via `value` /
`onValueChange` or uncontrolled via `defaultValue`; `type="single" |
"multiple"` controls whether one or many items may be open. Subparts:
`Accordion.Item`, `Accordion.Trigger`, `Accordion.Panel`.

name: Activity
description:
Vertical activity feed. Pair with `Activity.Item` children — each
item shows a rail marker, an actor, an action, and a timestamp.
Intended for audit logs, commit histories, and notification streams.

name: AgentRunner
description:
Orchestrates a live agent run: streams reasoning steps, tool calls, and
output into a scrollable trace. Feed `steps` (or an async iterable via
`onStep`) and it renders the history plus current status.

name: AgentStep
description:
Single step in an agent trace: a numbered card with title, status pill,
optional tool calls, output, and elapsed time. Controllable/uncontrolled
via `expanded` / `defaultExpanded` / `onExpandedChange`.

name: AgentTrace
description:
Full trace view for an agent run — wraps a list of `AgentStep`s with
status summary and expand-all controls.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the user clicks the stop button during a running/streaming agent.

name: Alert
description:
Inline notice block with a `tone` (`info` | `success` | `warning` |
`danger`), optional `title`, icon, and dismiss affordance. For transient
popups use `Toast`; for blocking confirmation use `Dialog` / `AlertDialog`.

name: AlertDialog
description:
Modal dialog that confirms a destructive or irreversible action. Like
`Dialog` but with enforced `Cancel` / `Confirm` affordances and
`role="alertdialog"` semantics.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render through a single consumer-provided element. See DialogCancel.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render through a single consumer-provided element. Avoids nesting
a `<button>` inside a `<button>` (which axe flags as
nested-interactive).

props.name: trapFocus
props.description: Disable focus trap. Default false.

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Disable focus restore on close.

props.name: modal
props.description: When false, the dialog renders inline without a Portal.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Focus this element when the dialog opens instead of the first focusable child.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description: Focus this element when the dialog closes instead of the previously-focused element.

props.name: monospace
props.description:
When true, renders the dialog body in a monospace font. Mirrors
`Card.monospace` / `DrawerV2.Content.monospace` for log/prompt/code-
content dialogs.

name: AlertV2
description:
Next-gen inline alert with richer layout slots (title, description,
actions, icon). Controllable dismissed state; tone mirrors `Alert`.

props.name: monospace
props.description:
When true, renders the alert body in a monospace font — suitable for CI
failure output, stack traces, or JSON payloads pasted into an alert.
Mirrors `Card.monospace` / `Dialog.Content.monospace`.

name: Anchor
description:
Styled `<a>` with safe-href validation, optional external-link affordance,
and tone variants. Rejects `javascript:` and other unsafe schemes with a
dev warning.

props.name: offset
props.description: Scroll offset for fixed headers. Default 80.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Smooth scroll on click. Default true.

props.name: affix
props.description: Make the nav sticky. Default false.

props.name: affixOffset
props.description: Top offset when affix is true.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Active indicator style. Default "line".

name: AppShell
description:
The top-level layout shell combining a sidebar, header, and main content area.
Provides a consistent application chrome with configurable sizing for each region.

props.name: sidebarWidth
props.description: Width of the sidebar. Default 240.

props.name: rightPanelWidth
props.description: Width of the right panel. Default 320.

props.name: sidebarCollapsible
props.description: When true, exposes a collapse toggle to hide the sidebar.

props.name: sidebarDefaultCollapsed
props.description: Initial collapsed state for the sidebar.

props.name: sidebarCollapsed
props.description: Controlled sidebar collapsed state.

props.name: sidebarResizable
props.description:
When true, adds a drag handle on the sidebar's trailing edge so users
can resize it. The width is reported via `onSidebarWidthChange` and
stays within `sidebarMinWidth`/`sidebarMaxWidth`.

props.name: sidebarMinWidth
props.description: Minimum width when resizing (px). Default 180.

props.name: sidebarMaxWidth
props.description: Maximum width when resizing (px). Default 480.

props.name: onSidebarWidthChange
props.description: Fires on each resize with the new width (px).

props.name: headerHeight
props.description: Height of the header in pixels/CSS value. Default "auto".

props.name: mobileBreakpoint
props.description: Viewport width at which the sidebar becomes a mobile overlay drawer. Default 768.

name: Arc
description:
Arc series primitive for donut / pie / gauge charts. Plots a radial slice
bound to a value range and consumes the enclosing chart scales.

props.name: onArcHover
props.type: ((datum: ArcDatum | null, index: number, e: PointerEvent<SVGPathElement>) => void)

name: Area
description:
Area series primitive for line/area charts. Fills between a baseline and a
datum series using the enclosing chart's X/Y scales.

props.name: fillOpacity
props.description: Fill opacity 0..1. Default 0.35.

name: AreaChart
description:
Area chart over a shared X axis. Axes: linear or time (X), linear (Y).
Interactions: hover crosshair, tooltip, legend toggle. Accepts `data` as
`{ x: number|Date; [series: string]: number }[]`.

props.name: scaleKind
props.description: Y-axis scale kind. Default "linear".

props.name: hiddenKeys
props.description: Series keys to hide (for interactive legend toggling).

name: ArrowDownIcon
description:
ArrowDown icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided.

props.name: directional
props.description:
Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically

props.name: spin
props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: AspectRatio
description:
Layout wrapper that locks its content to a given `ratio` (e.g. `16/9`).
Works in flex/grid parents without JS measurement.

name: AsyncData
description:
Universal async-data envelope. Eliminates per-component
`loading ? <Skeleton /> : data ? <Table /> : <Empty />` boilerplate
by routing to the correct slot based on `status`.

props.name: status
props.description: The current state. Determines which slot renders.

props.name: data
props.description: The data, available when `status === "success"`.

props.name: error
props.description: Error payload, available when `status === "error"`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Render while loading. Defaults to a minimal skeleton.

props.name: empty
props.description: Render when the dataset is empty.

props.name: renderError
props.description: Render when loading failed. Receives the error + a retry handle.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Callback wired into the default error UI's retry button.

name: Attachment
description:
Single attachment chip: icon, filename, size, optional preview / download
affordances. Used inside `AttachmentList` and the composer.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: When true, hides the default action buttons (for read-only displays).

name: AttachmentList
description:
Horizontal list of `Attachment` chips with overflow handling. Feed `items`
as `{ id, name, size, kind, url }[]`.

name: AudioAttachment
description:
Attachment variant for audio files — shows duration and a compact inline
`AudioPlayer` on expand.

name: AudioPlayer
description:
Accessible audio player with play/pause, scrub bar, time readout, and
volume. Wraps the native `<audio>` element and exposes keyboard controls.

name: Avatar
description: Circular or rounded image for a person or entity with initial / icon fallback. Sizes (`xs`-`xl`), tones, and `loading="lazy" | "eager"` pass through to the underlying ``.

props.name: color
props.description: Color (sets `--vf-accent`).

props.name: fallback
props.description: Explicit fallback text (overrides derived initials).

props.name: square
props.description: Render a square (non-rounded) avatar.

name: AvatarGroup
description:
Overlapping stack of `Avatar`s with an optional `+N` overflow chip. `max`
caps the visible count; the rest collapse into the overflow indicator.

name: Axis
description:
Chart axis primitive. Renders ticks, gridlines, and an axis label for the
enclosing chart's X or Y scale. Compose with `ChartFrame`.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Target tick count. Ignored for band/point scales. Default 5.

props.name: format
props.description: Custom label formatter.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional axis title placed at the far end.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Auto-rotates labels 45° when they would overlap. Default true for X axes.

props.name: tickSize
props.description: Tick line length in px. Default 6.

props.name: hideLine
props.description: Hide the axis baseline. Default false.

props.name: hideTickLines
props.description: Hide tick lines but keep labels. Default false.

props.name: hideLabels
props.description: Hide tick labels. Default false.

name: Backdrop
description:
Dimmed scrim rendered behind overlays. Handles click-outside and fade
transitions; used internally by `Dialog`, `Drawer`, and `Modal`.

name: BackToTop
description:
Floating button that scrolls the page (or a configured container) back to
the top once the user has scrolled past a threshold.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Scroll threshold (pixels) before the button becomes visible. Default 300.

name: Badge
description:
Small categorical label for status chips, counts, and highlights. Tone
(`neutral`/`success`/`danger`/`warning`/`info`), variant (`solid`/`outline`/
`ghost`/`subtle`), and size knobs. Supports a leading dot glyph, optional
icon, dismissible close button, and a `count` + `overflowCount` counter mode.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent color (hex). Sets `--vf-accent`.

props.name: dot
props.description: Render a leading dot glyph instead of full background.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Renders a close button after the label.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Callback when the close button is clicked.

props.name: count
props.description: When set, renders the count as the label (ignoring children).

props.name: overflowCount
props.description: When count exceeds this, displays `{overflowCount}+`.

name: BannerAlert
description:
Full-width banner alert anchored to the top (or bottom) of a layout.
Heavier than `Alert`; use for site-wide notices.

name: Bar
description:
Bar series primitive. Draws rectangles for each datum using the enclosing
chart's band/linear scales.

props.name: fillFor
props.description: Per-bar override. Return undefined to use the default `fill`.

props.name: onBarHover
props.type: ((datum: BarDatum | null, index: number, e: PointerEvent<SVGRectElement>) => void)

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius. Default 0 (brutalist).

name: BarChart
description:
Vertical or horizontal bar chart (grouped, stacked, or 100%-stacked).
Axes: band (category) x linear (value). Interactions: hover highlight,
legend toggle, optional brush.

props.name: mode
props.description: `"grouped"` (default) renders side-by-side bars; other modes stack.

props.name: padding
props.description: Band padding 0..1. Default 0.2.

props.name: innerPadding
props.description: Padding between sub-bars within a group (grouped mode). Default 0.1.

props.name: valueTicks
props.description: Custom value tick count for the continuous axis. Default 5.

props.name: scaleKind
props.description: Y-axis scale kind. Default "linear".

props.name: hiddenKeys
props.description: Series keys to hide (for interactive legend toggling).

props.name: onBarClick
props.type: ((payload: { datum: BarChartDatum; seriesKey: string; value: number; }) => void)

name: Barcode
description:
Renders a scannable 1D barcode from a value.

Requires the optional peer dependency `jsbarcode` to produce real
output. When the peer is missing OR still loading, the component
renders a clearly-labelled placeholder pattern. Bypass both by
passing a pre-computed `pattern` prop (1 = bar, 0 = gap).

props.name: height
props.description: Height in px.

props.name: barWidth
props.description: Pixel width per "unit" bar. Default 2.

props.name: pattern
props.description:
Pre-computed binary bar pattern (1 = bar, 0 = gap). Bypasses both
the peer-dep encoder and the placeholder. Takes precedence when
set.

name: BellIcon
description:
Bell icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided.

props.name: directional
props.description:
Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically
under `[dir="rtl"]`.

props.name: spin
props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: BigNumber
description:
Large hero metric: value, optional delta/trend, and caption. Use inside
dashboards; pair with `Sparkline` for an inline trend.

props.name: deltaTone
props.description: Tone for the delta chip.

name: BoldIcon
description:
Bold icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

name: Box
description: Generic box with token-aware shorthand props.

name: BoxPlot
description:
Box-and-whisker plot. Axes: band (category) x linear (value). Shows
quartiles, median, whiskers, and optional outliers per category.

props.name: whiskerK
props.description: IQR whisker multiplier. Default 1.5.

name: Breadcrumb
description:
Breadcrumb trail as a WAI-ARIA `nav` + `ol`. Dual API: pass `items`
(label/href/onClick) or compose `Breadcrumb.Item` children. Customize
the `separator` and collapse middle segments with `maxItems`.

props.name: items
props.description: Legacy items array. Compound `<Breadcrumb.Item>` children are preferred.

props.name: separator
props.description: Separator between segments. Default "/".

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Collapse the middle segments behind an ellipsis when the count exceeds this.

name: BreadcrumbMenu
description:
Breadcrumb variant where the middle segments collapse into a dropdown menu
when space is tight.

name: Brush
description:
Chart brush primitive: a draggable window that scopes the visible domain.
Emits `onChange(range)` for coordinating focus+context charts.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selection.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Default (uncontrolled) selection.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires while dragging and on release.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Fires only when the user releases the pointer.

props.name: minWidth
props.description:
Minimum width of the selection, in px. Default 6. When the user's
drag-end selection is narrower than `minWidth`, the selection is
cleared (emits `null`) rather than snapping to the minimum.

props.name: axis
props.description: Restrict to the X axis (default) or Y axis.

name: BubbleChart
description: Alias — "BubbleChart" is just ScatterPlot with sizeRange used.

props.name: series
props.description: Optional series definitions. When omitted, all points share defaults.

props.name: sizeRange
props.description: Map point size values to pixel radius range. Default `[3, 18]`.

props.name: shape
props.description: Use a circle glyph instead of the brutalist square. Default square.

props.name: scaleKind
props.description: Y-axis scale kind. Default "linear".

name: BubbleMap
description:
Geographic bubble map. Plots value-sized circles over a TopoJSON base map.
Peer: `d3-geo` + `topojson-client`.

props.name: sizeRange
props.description: Bubble size range, in px radius. Default `[3, 32]`.

props.name: color
props.description: Default bubble color. Default accent green.

name: Button
description:
Primary interactive button. Five variants (`solid`, `outline`, `ghost`,
`subtle`, `destructive`), four sizes including `icon` (square 1:1 aspect),
tone vocabulary (`neutral` / `info` / `success` / `danger` / `warning`)
mirroring Badge/AlertV2/Card, optional `iconLeft` / `iconRight`, loading
spinner, and polymorphic `asChild` for slot-style composition. Memoized so
re-renders are skipped when props are referentially stable.

props.name: onClick
props.description:
Click handler. Receives the native `MouseEvent` so consumers can call
`stopPropagation()` / `preventDefault()` when the button is nested inside
a clickable row or card. (Prior to 1.1.0 the signature was `() => void`;
the event param is additive — existing zero-arg handlers keep working.)

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color for `solid` and `subtle` variants. Sets `--vf-accent`.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Semantic tone. Adds `data-tone="…"` + `vf-button--tone-…` class and, for
`danger`/`warning`/`success`, primes `--vf-accent` to the matching token
so solid/subtle variants render in-tone without manual `accent=`.
Mirrors the Badge/AlertV2/Card tone vocabulary.

props.name: loading
props.description: When true, renders a spinner before children and disables the button.

props.name: iconLeft
props.description: Icon rendered before children. Replaced by spinner when loading.

props.name: iconRight
props.description: Icon rendered after children.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render through `<Slot>` and merge styles onto a single child element.

name: ButtonGroup
description:
Horizontal group of buttons with unified borders. Accepts `Button` or
`IconButton` children and exposes `attached` / `size` / `variant` props.

name: Calendar
description:
Month-grid calendar with optional events / event-renderer.
Memoized at the export site so parent re-renders with referentially-
stable `value` / `onChange` / `events` skip the 42-cell tree walk.

props.name: renderDay
props.description:
Optional renderer for the body of each month-view day cell. Receives the
day's `Date` and the events that fall on it; returns the inner content
to render under the day-number header. Use to display rich event
detail (e.g. nested ranges, agent activity, custom badges) without
forking the whole component.

props.name: expandedDay
props.description:
Optional content rendered as an expanded panel below the month/week/day
grid for the currently-selected day. Use for "click a day, show its
detail beneath" patterns without composing a separate Drawer/Sheet.

name: CalendarHeatmap
description:
GitHub-style calendar heatmap. Bins values per day and shades cells by
intensity; supports weekly or monthly layout.

props.name: colors
props.defaultValue:
[
  "var(--vf-bg-3)",
  "color-mix(in srgb, var(--vf-green) 35%, var(--vf-bg-3))",
  "color-mix(in srgb, var(--vf-green) 55%, transparent)",
  "color-mix(in srgb, var(--vf-green) 75%, transparent)",
  "var(--vf-green)",
]
props.description: Color buckets low→high. Default 5 greens.

props.name: showDayLabels
props.description: Display the day-of-week labels down the left edge. Default true.

props.name: showMonthLabels
props.description: Display month labels above the grid. Default true.

name: CalendarIcon
description:
Calendar icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided.

props.name: directional
props.description:
Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically
under `[dir="rtl"]`.

props.name: spin
props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: Callout
description:
Emphasised inline block with an icon, title, and body. Similar to `Alert`
but for editorial / doc-style calls rather than runtime notices.

name: CandlestickChart
description:
OHLC candlestick chart. Axes: time x linear. Each datum is `{ date, open,
high, low, close }`; wicks and bodies render per standard candle
conventions.

props.name: variant
props.description: `"candle"` (default) draws filled bodies, `"ohlc"` draws tick marks.

props.name: xTicks
props.description:
Preferred tick count on the x axis. Note: the candle chart renders its
x axis on a band scale; band scales emit one tick per category, so this
value is ignored when the chart has category-typed input. Kept for
future compatibility with linear/time x scales.

props.name: upColor
props.description: Up tone (close > open). Default `var(--vf-green)`.

props.name: downColor
props.description: Down tone (close < open). Default `var(--vf-red)`.

name: Card
description:
Brutalist content container with a bordered surface. Optional `title` /
`subtitle` / `headerRight` header slot and `actions` footer slot. Use
`hoverable` for a lift-on-hover effect, `monospace` for log/code content,
or `asChild` to render a custom element (link, button) while keeping card
styling.

props.name: hoverable
props.description: Adds hover elevation effect via CSS class.

props.name: monospace
props.description:
When true, renders the card body in a monospace font stack with a
slightly reduced size. Intended for CI log output, prompt dumps, raw
JSON traces, code snippets pasted into a card, etc.

props.name: actions
props.description: Renders in a footer actions slot after children.

props.name: collapsible
props.description:
When true, renders the card header as a clickable disclosure toggle so
the body collapses in-place. Mirrors `Sidebar.Section` / `Accordion`
collapse semantics without reparenting the content. Controllable via
`open` + `onOpenChange`; uncontrolled via `defaultOpen`.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state (only meaningful when `collapsible`).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state (only meaningful when `collapsible`). Default true.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the open state changes.

name: CaretIcon
description:
Caret icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided.

props.name: directional
props.description:
Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically
under `[dir="rtl"]`.

props.name: spin
props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: Carousel
description:
Horizontally-paged carousel with arrow + dot controls. Keyboard:
arrow-keys navigate slides. `loop` wraps; `autoplay` advances
automatically.

props.name: slides
props.description: Slide-array shorthand. Compound subcomponents take precedence.

props.name: interval
props.description: Auto-advance interval in ms. Default 4000.

props.name: slidesPerView
props.description: Visible slides per viewport.

name: CarouselImageGallery
description:
Image gallery built on `Carousel` with lightbox-on-click, thumbnails
strip, and keyboard navigation.

props.name: kenBurns
props.description: Apply a subtle Ken Burns zoom while a slide is active.

props.name: interval
props.description: Auto-advance interval in ms. Default 4000.

description:
Countdown timer to a target date/time. Auto-updates every second; fires
`onComplete` when it hits zero.

props.name: format
props.description: Format of the remaining time.

props.name: completedLabel
props.description: Render after completion. Defaults to "0:00".

name: CronBuilder
description:
Visual builder for a cron expression. Controllable via `value` /
`onChange`; emits the standard five-field string.

props.name: presets
props.defaultValue:
[
  { label: "Every minute", value: "* * * * *" },
  { label: "Every hour", value: "0 * * * *" },
  { label: "Daily midnight", value: "0 0 * * *" },
  { label: "Weekly Monday 9am", value: "0 9 * * 1" },
  { label: "Monthly 1st", value: "0 0 1 * *" },
]

props.name: fields
props.description:
Number of fields in the cron expression. 5 = standard UNIX
(minute / hour / day / month / weekday); 6 = Quartz-style with a leading
seconds field. Defaults to the width of the current `value` / `defaultValue`,
falling back to 5.

name: Crosshair
description:
Chart crosshair primitive: follows the pointer with vertical/horizontal
rule lines and highlights the nearest datum.

props.name: x
props.description: Position in plot-space (after ChartFrame margins).

props.name: showPoint
props.description: Render a dot at `(x, y)` when mode is `"both"` and both are provided.

props.name: dashed
props.description: Dashed strokes instead of solid. Default true.

name: CSVViewer
description: Parse CSV with support for quoted fields containing delimiters and newlines.

name: CurrencyDisplay
description:
Locale-aware currency formatter via `Intl.NumberFormat`. Takes a numeric
`value`, ISO currency code, and optional precision override.

props.name: autoTone
props.description:
Render positive/negative/zero with semantic tone classes.
Default: no tone.

name: CurrencyInput
description:
Numeric input with currency formatting and live-masked editing. Emits the
raw numeric value to `onValueChange`.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled numeric value (null = empty).

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code. Default "USD".

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale. Default uses navigator.language.

props.name: allowNegative
props.description: Allow negative values.

props.name: maximumFractionDigits
props.description: Max fraction digits (default taken from Intl for the currency).

props.name: minimumFractionDigits
props.description: Min fraction digits (default 2 for most currencies).

name: CursorPagination
description:
Cursor-based pagination with prev / next buttons for APIs that page by
cursor token rather than offset. Drive button enablement via `hasPrev`
/ `hasNext` and wire `onPrev` / `onNext`; `loading` disables both.

name: DashboardGrid
description:
Responsive dashboard grid with configurable columns per breakpoint.
Children can span columns/rows via `GridItem`.

props.name: cols
props.description: Total sub-cell columns across the canvas. Default 24.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Pixel size of one sub-cell side. Default 32.

props.name: gap
props.description: Pixel gap between sub-cells. Default 4.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Render function per item.

props.name: movable
props.description: Allow click-drag to move cards. Default true.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Show corner-resize grips on each card. Default false.

props.name: minW
props.description: Min sub-cell width when resizing. Default 2.

props.name: minH
props.description: Min sub-cell height when resizing. Default 2.

props.name: maxW
props.description: Max sub-cell width. Default `cols`.

props.name: maxH
props.description: Max sub-cell height. Defaults to bounds rows or unbounded.

props.name: bounds
props.description:
`"auto"` (default) grows the canvas in both axes to fit the
furthest card; pass `{ rows: N }` for a fixed sub-cell row count
(horizontal still grows past `cols` if a card requires it).

props.name: autoPaddingRows
props.description: Empty rows below the lowest card when growing vertically. Default 4.

props.name: autoPaddingCols
props.description:
Empty columns to the right of the furthest card when growing
horizontally. Default 4.

props.name: collisionSearchCap
props.description:
Upper bound on the number of candidate cells the collision-avoidance
search will evaluate before bailing out. Default 4000 — enough for
grids up to ~60×60 sub-cells. Raise this if you have a very dense,
large canvas and are seeing drop targets snap to arbitrary positions;
lower it to cap worst-case CPU on pathological layouts.

name: DatabaseIcon
description:
Database icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided.

props.name: directional
props.description:
Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically
under `[dir="rtl"]`.

props.name: spin
props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: onSortChange
props.type: ((next: { key: string; direction: SortDirection; } | null) => void)

props.name: rootRef
props.description:
Ref to the DataGrid's root `<div>`. Accepts the usual ref shapes
(callback or `React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>`). Exposed as a named
prop instead of a generic `forwardRef` wrapper so the generic type
parameter `T` stays inferrable from `columns`/`data` without
propagation gymnastics.

props.name: virtualized
props.description: When true, delegates body rendering to a VirtualList. Requires `virtualRowHeight`.

props.name: onRowReorder
props.description: Drag to reorder rows. Emits a pair of indices (within the filtered view).

props.name: onColumnReorder
props.description: Drag header to reorder columns.

props.name: persistKey
props.description: When set, column widths / visibility / order persist to localStorage under this key.

props.name: rowAttributes
props.description:
Return arbitrary HTML attributes to apply to each rendered row. Use for
`data-testid`, `aria-*`, per-row event listeners, etc. — tests can then
query rows by attribute instead of content or injected marker spans.

name: DataList
description:
Read-only list of label/value rows for summaries and key/value UIs.
Dual API: pass an `items` array, or compose `DataList.Item` children.
`orientation="horizontal"` (default) renders a two-column grid;
`"vertical"` stacks label above value.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Orientation. Default "horizontal" (2-col).

props.name: itemAttributes
props.description:
Return arbitrary HTML attributes to apply to each rendered row when the
array-API (`items`) is used. Tests / instrumentation can attach
`data-testid` / `aria-*` per row without falling back to content-based
queries. The compound API (`<DataList.Item>`) already accepts spread
props directly.

name: DatePicker
description:
A text input paired with a popover calendar; selecting a date fills the input.
Supports keyboard entry, format parsing, and min/max bounds.

props.name: format
props.description: Output/input format. Default "yyyy-MM-dd".

props.name: parseFormat
props.description: Pattern used to parse typed input when `format` is a string. Defaults to `format`.

props.name: inline
props.description: Render calendar always open (no popover trigger).

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size variant — `"sm" | "md" | "lg"`. Default `"md"`.

props.name: wrapperProps
props.description: Props forwarded to the outer wrapper `<div>`.

name: DateRangePicker
description:
Two-month calendar for picking a date range. Controllable via `value` /
`onChange`; keyboard-navigable.

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: Number of months shown side-by-side (1 or 2). Default 2.

name: DateTimePicker
description:
Combined date + time picker. Controllable via `value` / `onChange`;
honours the user's locale for format.

props.name: datePickerProps
props.description: DatePicker props forwarded through.

props.name: timeFormat
props.description: TimePicker format (12h / 24h).

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size variant — `"sm" | "md" | "lg"`. Default `"md"`.

props.name: wrapperProps
props.description: Props forwarded to the outer wrapper `<div>`.

name: DebugPanel
description:
Developer drawer that visualises agent internals: prompt, tool calls, raw
response, timing. Development-only.

name: DebugTree
description:
Collapsible tree view for nested debug data (state, props, JSON). Lighter
than `JSONViewer`.

props.name: format
props.description: Serialization format. Default `"json"` (uses the collapsible viewer).

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Depth to expand initially. Default 1. `true` expands all. Ignored for YAML.

name: DependencyGraph
description:
Directed graph of dependencies with hierarchical layout. Useful for module
/ package / task graphs.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction of layering. Default `"top-down"`.

props.name: nodeWidth
props.description: Pixel size of each node. Default 96 × 32.

props.name: layerGap
props.description: Pixel gap between layers. Default 64.

props.name: siblingGap
props.description: Pixel gap between siblings within a layer. Default 32.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Click a node to highlight its neighbourhood. Default true.

props.name: directed
props.description: Render arrowheads on edges. Default true.

name: DescriptionList
description:
Semantic `<dl>` list of term/description pairs. Responsive: stacks below
`sm` and lays out in a grid above.

name: Descriptions
description:
Compact form of `DescriptionList` optimised for dense detail views (e.g.
entity metadata cards).

name: Dialog
description:
Compound modal overlay. Use `Dialog.Trigger` to open, `Dialog.Content`
for the body, `Dialog.Close` to dismiss. Focus-trapped, portaled, and
ESC-dismissable by default. Compose with `Dialog.Title` / `Dialog.Description`
for accessible labelling. Controlled via `open` / `onOpenChange`; pass
`kind="alertdialog"` for destructive-confirmation flows.

props.name: kind
props.description: "alertdialog" tweaks role + initial focus for destructive flows.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render through a single consumer-provided element. See DialogCancel.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render through a single consumer-provided element. Avoids nesting
a `<button>` inside a `<button>` (which axe flags as
nested-interactive).

props.name: trapFocus
props.description: Disable focus trap. Default false.

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Disable focus restore on close.

props.name: modal
props.description: When false, the dialog renders inline without a Portal.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Focus this element when the dialog opens instead of the first focusable child.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description: Focus this element when the dialog closes instead of the previously-focused element.

props.name: monospace
props.description:
When true, renders the dialog body in a monospace font. Mirrors
`Card.monospace` / `DrawerV2.Content.monospace` for log/prompt/code-
content dialogs.

name: DiffViewer
description:
Unified / side-by-side text diff view with line numbers and hunk
navigation. Feed `before` + `after` strings.

name: DismissableLayer
description:
Handles Escape-to-dismiss and click-outside-to-dismiss for overlays.
Stacks correctly with nested layers: only the topmost responds to Escape.

Does NOT trap focus — compose with `<FocusScope>` for full modal semantics.

props.name: onEscapeKeyDown
props.description: Fires on Escape if this layer is topmost.

props.name: onPointerDownOutside
props.description: Fires on pointer-down outside the layer.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shorthand: fires for both Escape and outside pointer-down.

name: Divider
description:
Horizontal or vertical rule used to separate groups of content. Optional
`label` renders a centred caption break.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Vertical margin in px. Defaults to `sp6` (12px) via CSS.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional inline label centered on the rule (horizontal only).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Orientation. Default "horizontal".

name: DocumentPreview
description:
Renders a preview for a document attachment (PDF / image / text). Falls
back to an icon + filename card.

props.name: thumbnail
props.description: Optional thumbnail URL. Falls back to glyph by `kind`.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Disable both action buttons.

name: DonutChart
description:
Donut (hollow pie) chart for part-of-whole data. Emits hover/select events
per slice and supports a centred summary slot.

props.name: innerRatio
props.description: Inner radius as a fraction of outer radius (0..1). 0 = pie, 0.6 = donut.

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Start angle in radians. Default `-Math.PI / 2` (12 o'clock).

props.name: size
props.description: Side length of the chart (width === height). Default 280.

name: Dots
description:
Small row of dots used as a step/progress indicator (e.g. carousel
pagination).

props.name: color
props.description: Color (sets `--vf-accent`).

props.name: size
props.description: Dot font-size in px.

name: DownloadIcon
description:
Download icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided.

props.name: directional
props.description:
Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically
under `[dir="rtl"]`.

props.name: spin
props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: DragDropContext
description:
Root provider for the drag-and-drop system. Wraps `Draggable` /
`Droppable` children and coordinates drag state.

props.name: onDragStart
props.type: ((event: { draggableId: string; source: { droppableId: string | null; index: number; }; }) => void)

name: Draggable
description:
Wraps a child to make it draggable inside a `DragDropContext`. Emits
lifecycle events for drag start, move, end.

props.name: index
props.description: When inside a Droppable, supply the list index for keyboard fallback.

props.name: droppableId
props.description: Optional droppable id this draggable belongs to.

name: Drawer
description:
V1 side-panel overlay with backdrop, focus trap, and Escape dismiss.
Controlled via `open` / `onDismiss` and anchored to `left` or `right`.

props.name: motion
props.description: Enable enter/exit animations. Default true.

props.name: adaptive
props.description: Expand to full-width below the `md` breakpoint. Default true.

name: DrawerV2
description:
Compound side-panel overlay. Slides in from any edge (`left`, `right`,
`top`, `bottom`). Use `DrawerV2.Trigger`, `DrawerV2.Content`, and
`DrawerV2.Close`; compose with `.Header`, `.Title`, `.Body`, `.Footer`.
Focus-trapped, scroll-locked when `modal`, and Escape-dismissable.
Controlled via `open` / `onOpenChange`.

props.name: side
props.description:
Override the `side` set on the `<DrawerV2>` root. Useful when a single
drawer instance swaps between sides at runtime (e.g. RTL flip, responsive
reorient). Defaults to the root's `side` when omitted — no behavior
change for existing consumers.

props.name: adaptive
props.description: Expand to full-width below the `md` breakpoint. Default true.

props.name: monospace
props.description:
When true, renders the drawer body in a monospace font — useful for
log-output drawers, prompt dumps, and code diffs. Mirrors `Card.monospace`.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Focus this element when the drawer opens instead of the first focusable child.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description: Focus this element when the drawer closes instead of the previously-focused element.

name: Dropdown
description:
Simple trigger + menu dropdown. For richer composition (submenus,
checkbox items, radio groups) use `Menu`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic tone — mirrors `MenuItem.tone`.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Semantic tone. Emits `data-tone` + `vf-menu__item--${tone}` so destructive
("Delete…"), warning, or success items style consistently without inline
styles. Mirrors Button/Badge/AlertV2 tone vocabulary.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render through `<Slot>` and merge menu semantics onto a consumer-provided element (e.g. a router link).

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic tone — mirrors `MenuItem.tone`.

name: Droppable
description:
Drop target inside a `DragDropContext`. Emits drop events with the dragged
payload.

name: DropZone
description:
File drop target with visual affordance and keyboard fallback (click to
open file picker). Emits `onFiles(files)`.

name: DurationDisplay
description:
Formats a millisecond duration as a human-readable string (`2m 13s`, `1h
04m`, etc.). Locale-aware.

name: EditIcon
description:
Edit icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided.

Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically

props.name: spin
props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: EmptyLayout
description:
Minimal layout shell with just a centred slot — for error pages, login
screens, etc.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Width cap for the centered content. Default "md".

name: EmptyState
description:
Centred illustration + title + description + optional action. Use when a
list/table/view has no data yet.

When neither `icon` nor `action` is supplied, the `"decorated"` variant
renders a default inbox glyph and a bordered tile so the no-props case
doesn't feel bare. Opt into `variant="plain"` for pre-styled containers.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual variant.
- `"decorated"` (default) — renders a default inbox glyph + framed tile
  when no explicit icon / action is supplied, so the no-props case still
  reads as intentional empty-UI instead of centred naked text.
- `"plain"` — skips the default icon + tile; just centres whatever props
  are passed. Use inside pre-styled containers.

name: EnvironmentVars
description:
Editor for key/value environment variable pairs. Masks values by default;
supports import/export.

name: ErrorBoundary
description:
Class-based error boundary. Catches render/effect errors in descendants,
renders `fallback`, and exposes `reset()` to recover.

props.name: fallback
props.description:
Fallback UI. Either a ReactNode (static) or a render function receiving
`(error, reset)` for interactive recovery.

props.name: onError
props.description: Invoked when a descendant throws.

props.name: resetKeys
props.description:
When any value in this array changes identity, the boundary auto-resets.
Useful when the underlying cause is tied to a prop or route.

name: ErrorIcon
description:
Error icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to

Centred error display: icon, title, message, and retry / support actions.

name: Field
description:
Compound form field wrapper. Auto-wires `htmlFor`, `aria-describedby`,
`aria-invalid`, and `aria-required` across its subcomponents via context.

props.name: invalid
props.description: When true, marks the rendered control as invalid via context.

name: Field.Error
description:
Error slot for `Field`. Renders only when the field's validation state is
invalid. Auto-wired to the control via `aria-describedby`.

name: Field.Help
description:
Help-text slot for `Field`. Auto-wired to the control via
`aria-describedby`.

name: Field.Label
description: Label slot for `Field`. Auto-wires `htmlFor` to the nested control.

name: FieldControl
description:
Wires a single form control (Input / Textarea / Select / ...) to the
surrounding `<Field>` — injects `id`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`,
`aria-required`, and `disabled`.

name: FieldSet
description: Native `<fieldset>` with Voidframe styling. Use with `<Legend>` inside.

props.name: collapsible
props.description:
Renders the fieldset as a collapsible section. Legend stays visible;
non-legend children are hidden when closed. Controlled via `open` +
`onOpenChange`; uncontrolled via `defaultOpen` (default `true`). Shares
the `useDisclosure` hook with `Card` and `Sidebar.Section` so the
collapsible-section pattern is uniform across the library.

name: FileAttachment
description:
Attachment variant for a generic file — shows filename, size, and
kind-specific icon.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: When true, hides the default action buttons (for read-only displays).

name: FileIcon

File icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

name: FileUpload
description:
File upload control with drag-drop, picker, progress per file, and list
management. Supports multiple files and size/type constraints.

props.name: accept
props.description: Comma-separated accept list (e.g. "image/*,application/pdf").

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow multiple files. Default `true`.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Maximum file count. Extra files are rejected with an error.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Maximum per-file bytes. Larger files are rejected with an error.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called whenever the selection changes.

props.name: upload
props.description:
Upload a single file. Receives a progress callback (0..1) and must
resolve when the upload succeeds. Throw to mark the item as errored.

props.name: renderSurface
props.description: Render custom upload surface. Receives the open-browse helper.

props.name: disableThumbnails
props.description: Disable image thumbnail generation.

props.name: inputProps
props.description:
Props forwarded to the inner native `<input type="file">` element. Use for
`data-testid`, `aria-*`, or other attributes consumers want on the
actual control.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size variant — `"sm" | "md" | "lg"`. Default `"md"`.

props.name: wrapperProps
props.description: Props forwarded to the outer wrapper `<div>`.

name: FilterBuilder
description:
Visual builder for structured filter expressions. Controllable via `value`
/ `onChange`; emits a nested condition tree.

Filter icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

description: Flexbox primitive. Foundation for HStack/VStack. Every visual prop accepts a `Responsive<T>` object for per-breakpoint values.

name: FloatingActionButton
description:
Fixed-position circular action button (material-style FAB). Anchored to a
corner; supports an optional expanded action tray.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual style. `"destructive"` is a parity alias for shadcn migrations —
cascades to `tone="danger"`.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Semantic tone. Mirrors Button/Badge. Emits `data-tone` + cascades to
`vf-fab--${tone}` BEM class.

props.name: offset

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Disables the FAB trigger (and any speed-dial actions cascade via their
own `FABAction.disabled`). Emits both native `disabled` and
`aria-disabled="true"` via the shared `buttonDisabledAttrs` helper.

name: FocusScope
description:
Trap Tab focus inside a region. Used by Modal, Drawer, Sheet, ConfirmDialog.

The rendered `<div>` is the focus boundary. Focusable descendants are
discovered via a query selector (see `FOCUSABLE`) plus visibility filtering.

props.name: trapped
props.description: When true (default), Tab/Shift+Tab are trapped inside this container.

props.name: loop
props.description: Loop from last → first (and first → last) when at the boundary.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the first focusable child (or `target`) on mount.

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Return focus to the element that was focused before mount, on unmount.

name: FolderIcon
description:
Folder icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided.

props.name: directional
props.description:
Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically
under `[dir="rtl"]`.

props.name: spin
props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: FolderOpenIcon
description:
FolderOpen icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided.

under `[dir="rtl"]`.

props.name: pulse

name: Form
description: Read the nearest `<Form>` context. Throws if not inside a `<Form>`.

name: FormActions
description:
Right-aligned footer for submit/cancel buttons. Flex container with
consistent gap. Respects LTR/RTL via `justify-content: flex-end` (maps
to end of the inline axis).

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment — default `end` (right-justified for LTR).

name: FormErrorSummary
description:
Renders a list of current form errors. Reads from `useFormContext`.
Only renders when there are errors.

props.name: heading
props.description: Override the heading. Default "Please fix the following:".

name: FormField
description:
Wrapper for form controls that renders an optional `label`, `required`
asterisk, and either an `error` message or `help` text below the input.
Warns in dev when `required` is set without a label or when both `error`
and `help` are provided.

name: FunnelChart
description:
Funnel / conversion chart — each stage is a trapezoid sized by value.
Shows drop-off between adjacent stages.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between steps. Default 4.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Orientation. Default `"vertical"` (top→bottom narrowing).

props.name: showPercent
props.description: Show a percent-of-top label inside each step. Default true.

name: Gantt
description:
Gantt timeline. Memoized at the export site so parent re-renders
with referentially-stable `tasks` / `start` / `end` skip the
SVG-bar / dependency-line render walk.

props.name: unitWidth
props.description: Width per granularity unit, in px. Default depends on granularity.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Disable drag interactions.

props.name: showToday
props.description: Show a vertical marker line at today's date. Default true.

name: Gauge
description:
Radial gauge for a single value in a range. Configurable arc span, tick
marks, and threshold bands.

name: Grid
description: CSS Grid wrapper. All visual props accept `Responsive<T>` objects.

name: GridItem
description:
Child of `DashboardGrid` (or any CSS-grid parent) that declares column/row
span per breakpoint.

name: Gridlines
description:
Chart gridlines primitive. Renders horizontal/vertical rules tied to tick
positions of the enclosing scales.

props.name: mode
props.description: Which axes to draw gridlines for. Default `"both"`.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Target tick count (continuous scales only). Default 5.

props.name: dashed
props.description: Render dashed gridlines instead of solid. Default false.

name: HeartIcon
description:
Heart icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided.

props.name: directional
props.description:
Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically
under `[dir="rtl"]`.

props.name: spin
props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: Heatmap
description:
Two-dimensional heatmap. Axes: band x band. Cells shade by intensity;
tooltip exposes raw value.

props.name: colors
props.defaultValue:
[
  "var(--vf-bg-3)",
  "color-mix(in srgb, var(--vf-blue) 35%, var(--vf-bg-3))",
  "color-mix(in srgb, var(--vf-blue) 55%, transparent)",
  "color-mix(in srgb, var(--vf-blue) 75%, transparent)",
  "var(--vf-blue)",
]
props.description: Color buckets low→high. Default 5 blues.

name: HelpTooltip
description:
Tooltip variant tuned for contextual help text — slightly wider, with a
`?` trigger convention.

name: HexDump
description:
Monospace hex+ASCII viewer for a buffer. Configurable bytes-per-row and
offset display.

name: Hide
description:
Conditional renderer: hides its children below / above / at specific
breakpoints. Paired with `Show`.

name: Histogram
description:
Binned frequency chart. Axes: linear (bin) x linear (count). Configurable
bin count or explicit thresholds.

props.name: bins
props.description: Approximate bin count. Default 20.

name: HomeIcon
description:
Home icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative

Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically
under `[dir="rtl"]`.

props.name: spin
props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: HorizonChart
description:
Horizon chart: stacked banded areas that encode large dynamic ranges
compactly. Good for many time-series densely packed.

props.name: bands
props.description: Number of horizon bands (also = color intensity steps). Default 3.

props.name: positiveColor
props.description: Color for positive values. Default `var(--vf-green)`.

props.name: negativeColor
props.description: Color for negative values. Default `var(--vf-red)`.

props.name: seriesLabel
props.description: Label shown in the tooltip for the series value. Default `"Value"`.

name: HorizontalTimeline
description:
Horizontal timeline of events with a scrollable track. Good for roadmaps
or release history.

name: HoverCard
description:
Open-on-hover anchored overlay for rich previews (profile cards, link
metadata). Compose `HoverCard.Trigger` and `HoverCard.Content`; content
is portaled and positioned with viewport-flip. Tune `openDelay` /
`closeDelay` (ms); hovering into the content cancels the close.

name: HStack
description: Horizontal stack — `flex-direction: row`, default align `center`.

name: HydrationBoundary
description:
Suspends a subtree from SSR. Useful for components that inherently
can't render server-side (canvas, measurements, time-of-day) without
introducing hydration mismatches.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Rendered on the server and until the first client render lands.

name: Icon
description:
Generic SVG icon wrapper. Takes a named glyph or arbitrary children,
normalises `size` and `color` tokens, and forwards to a `role="img"` /
`aria-label`ed `<svg>` when `label` is present (decorative otherwise).
Memoized — icons render frequently inside rows/lists.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided.

props.name: directional
props.description:
Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically
under `[dir="rtl"]`.

props.name: spin
props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: IconButton
description:
Icon-only button. Requires `aria-label` (or `aria-labelledby`) so screen
readers announce the action; dev warns without one.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Semantic tone. Mirrors Button/Badge/AlertV2. Sets `data-tone` + a
`vf-icon-button--tone-…` modifier, and primes `--vf-accent` to the
matching token when no explicit `accent` is passed.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Short text shown on hover / focus above the button.

props.name: active
props.description: Toggle state.

name: IconGroup
description:
Compact group of icons displayed inline (e.g. status badges). Optional
overflow chip.

name: Identicon
description:
Deterministic pixel/shape avatar generated from a seed string. Useful
fallback when a user has no uploaded avatar.

props.name: background
props.description: Background color; defaults to transparent-ish.

name: IFrame
description:
Sandboxed `<iframe>` wrapper with safe defaults (no top navigation,
restricted sandbox). Emits `onLoad`.

props.name: title
props.description: Required for screen-reader accessibility.

props.name: sandbox
props.description: Sandbox tokens. Default `"allow-scripts allow-forms"`.

name: Image
description: Responsive image with intrinsic ratio, optional placeholder / blur-up, and lazy loading. Wraps the native ``.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Numeric ratio (`16 / 9`) or string (`"16 / 9"`).

props.name: blurDataUrl
props.description: Used when `placeholder="blur"` — pass a tiny base64 image.

name: ImageAttachment
description:
Attachment variant for images — shows a thumbnail plus filename/size
metadata.

name: ImageCropper
description:
Interactive image cropper. Emits the cropped region as a data URL or
`Blob` on commit.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL to crop. If not provided, the component shows a file picker.

props.name: aspect
props.description: Lock the crop window to this width/height ratio (e.g. 1 for square).

props.name: initialCrop
props.description: Initial crop rect in natural image coords. Defaults to 80% centered.

props.name: outputType
props.description: Mime type of the emitted blob. Default "image/png".

props.name: outputQuality
props.description: Quality for lossy formats (0..1).

props.name: onCrop
props.description: Called when the user confirms a crop.

props.name: onSrcChange
props.description: Called when a new src is loaded — useful for file pickers.

props.name: allowFileSelect
props.description: Expose file upload. Default `true` when no `src` provided.

name: ImageDiff
description: Two-image comparison viewer: slider, side-by-side, or onion-skin modes.

name: ImageGallery
description: Grid or masonry image gallery with click-to-open `Lightbox` integration.

props.name: noLightbox
props.description: Disable the Lightbox (gallery only).

name: InfiniteScroll
description:
Infinite scroll loader. Calls `onLoadMore` when the sentinel enters the
viewport; renders a loading indicator slot.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Threshold 0..1 of the parent scroll before triggering load. Default 0.8.

props.name: scrollParent
props.description: When supplied, observes this element's scroll. Otherwise observes window.

name: InfoIcon
description:
Info icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided.

props.name: directional
props.description:
Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically
under `[dir="rtl"]`.

props.name: spin
props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: InlineEdit
description:
Click-to-edit text field: displays a value until clicked, then renders an
input with Save/Cancel.

props.name: onSave
props.description:
Called with the committed draft after validation passes. The parent is
expected to propagate the change back into `value`; InlineEdit treats
`value` as authoritative for the display state, so if the upstream state
update lags (async/rejected), the displayed value may briefly trail the
value the user just typed.

props.name: autoSelect
props.description: Select all text on entering edit mode. Default true.

props.name: submitOnBlur
props.description: Save on blur. Default true.

props.name: submitOnEnter
props.description: Save on Enter key. Default true.

name: Input
description: A single-line text field with optional label and standard HTML input types.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Raw event handler — kept for backward compatibility. Prefer `onValueChange`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Value-emit handler — matches the convention used by every other voidframe form component.

props.name: size
props.description:
Voidframe-native size variant. The native `size` attribute (visible-
character count) is exposed as `lengthSize` so both axes are
independently controllable.

props.name: lengthSize
props.description: Native `HTMLInputElement.size` — visible character count.

props.name: asAriaLabel
props.description:
Accessible-name escape hatch. When set, emits as `aria-label` and
suppresses the missing-name warning. Use for inline controls inside
data-dense UIs where a visible label would be redundant.

props.name: suppressA11yWarning
props.description: Internal escape hatch for voidframe-composed parents.

name: InputGroup.Addon
description:
Non-interactive addon slot for `InputGroup` (e.g. a leading currency sign
or trailing unit).

name: ItalicIcon
description:
Italic icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided.

props.name: directional
props.description:
Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically
under `[dir="rtl"]`.

props.name: spin
props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: JSONViewer
description:
Collapsible JSON tree with type colouring, copy-path affordance, and
search. Handles large payloads via virtualisation.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Depth to expand initially. Default 1. Pass `true` for all.

props.name: defaultExpandAll
props.description: Start with all nodes expanded.

name: Kanban
description:
Kanban board with column-bounded drag/drop. Memoized at the export
site so re-rendering a parent with unrelated state doesn't re-render
the full board grid; consumers can rely on referentially-stable
`items` / `onMove` callbacks for the optimization to actually fire.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show a search input above the board.

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Callback for search input changes. When omitted, client-side filtering is used.

props.name: getSearchable
props.description:
Customize which fields contribute to the built-in client-side search
filter. Return a list of strings to match against. Defaults to
`[title, label]` when they are strings.

name: Kbd
description:
Renders a keyboard shortcut label (e.g. `Cmd`+`K`). Accepts an array of
tokens for multi-key chords.

props.name: keys
props.description: Combo string (e.g. "Cmd+K"). Use children for single-key form.

name: KeyValue
description:
Single label/value row. Used inside `DataList` / `Descriptions`;
standalone for inline metadata.

name: KeyValueEditor
description:
Editable list of key/value rows. Supports add/remove/reorder; emits the
full array on change.

name: Label
description:
Accessible form label that associates with its control via `htmlFor`.
`<Field>` wires this automatically.

name: LatencyIndicator
description:
Colour-coded indicator for a latency reading (ms). Thresholds
configurable.

props.name: value
props.description: Latency in ms.

props.name: kind
props.description:
Layout variant. `"default"` renders label + value; `"compact"` shows
only the value pill — matches the compact vocabulary of the other chat
telemetry widgets (`ContextWindow`, `ChatTokenCounter`, `CostDisplay`).

name: LegalText
description:
Small-print legal prose container with conservative typography. Use for
ToS excerpts, disclaimers, footnotes.

name: Legend
description: Native `<legend>` with Voidframe styling.

name: Lightbox
description:
Full-screen image viewer with prev/next navigation, zoom, and keyboard
controls (arrow keys, Esc to close).

props.name: download
props.description: Allow the user to download the current image.

name: Line
description:
Line series primitive for line / area / composed charts. Connects points
from the enclosing chart's scales.

props.name: dashed
props.description: Dashed stroke. Default false.

name: LineChart
description:
Line chart over a shared X axis. Axes: linear or time (X), linear (Y).
Interactions: hover crosshair, tooltip, legend toggle.

props.name: scaleKind
props.description: Y-axis scale kind. Default "linear".

props.name: hiddenKeys
props.description: Series keys to hide (for interactive legend toggling).

props.name: connectNulls
props.description: When true, null / undefined values are skipped and surrounding points connect. Default false.

name: Link
description:
Text link primitive. Inherits voidframe accent + focus treatment. Use
`as` to integrate with router-link components while keeping styling.

props.name: as
props.description:
Render as a different element or framework-specific link component
(e.g. react-router's `Link`). The value receives the same props the
default `<a>` would get. Defaults to native `<a>`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual variant.
- `"inline"` (default) — underlined accent-color link, suitable inside
  prose.
- `"standalone"` — no underline; block-style link for nav / CTAs.
- `"muted"` — low-emphasis; muted text color, underline on hover.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Semantic tone. Mirrors Button/Badge. Emits `data-tone` + primes
`--vf-accent` when set.

props.name: external
props.description:
Mark a link as external. Auto-adds `target="_blank"` + secure rel
values (`noopener noreferrer`) if not explicitly set.

name: LinkIcon
description:
Link icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

name: List
description:
Vertical list with configurable separators, density, and selection.
Compound: `List.Item`.

props.name: items
props.description: Legacy array API. Compound `<List.Item>` children are preferred.

name: LiveIndicator
description:
Pulsing dot + label indicating a live feed / stream state. Tones mirror
status palette.

name: LiveRegion
description:
Declarative `aria-live` region. Consumers drive announcements via `message`.

For imperative announcements (Toast queues etc.) use `useAnnouncer()`.

props.name: message
props.description: Message text. Setting it announces to screen readers.

props.name: clearAfter
props.description: Clear the message this many ms after it's announced.

name: LoadingDotsIcon
description:
LoadingDots icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

name: LoadingOverlay
description:
Semi-transparent scrim with a centred spinner, overlaid on a
relatively-positioned parent while async work is in flight.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent color override (sets --vf-accent).

name: LockIcon
description:
Lock icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

description:
Terminal-style log viewer with level filters, timestamp toggle, search,
and auto-scroll-to-bottom.

props.name: pausable
props.description: Show pause/resume button. Default true.

props.name: filterable
props.description: Show regex filter input. Default true.

props.name: entryAttributes
props.description:
Return arbitrary HTML attributes for each rendered log entry. Mirrors
`Table.rowAttributes` — tests can attach `data-testid` per entry.

name: MailIcon
description:
Mail icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to
`role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided.

props.name: directional
props.description:
Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically
under `[dir="rtl"]`.

props.name: spin
props.description: Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: MarkdownEditor
description:
Markdown editor with live preview. Sanitises rendered HTML via DOMPurify
(peer dependency).

name: MarkdownRenderer
description:
Safe markdown renderer. Sanitises HTML via DOMPurify (peer dependency);
supports code blocks, tables, task lists.

props.name: linkTarget
props.description: Opens links in a new tab when set.

props.name: plugins
props.description: Pre-process the markdown source through these plugins in order.

props.name: components
props.type: Partial<{ h1: ElementType<any, keyof IntrinsicElements>; h2: ElementType<any, keyof IntrinsicElements>; h3: ElementType<any, keyof IntrinsicElements>; ... 14 more ...; br: ElementType<...>; }>
props.description: Replace specific tags with custom React components.

name: Marquee
description:
Scrolling marquee for long inline content. Respects
`prefers-reduced-motion` and pauses on hover.

props.name: speed
props.description: Pixels per second. Default 50.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between two duplicated content tracks.

name: MaskedInput
description:
Text input with a display mask (e.g. `###-##-####`). Emits the unmasked
value to `onValueChange`.

props.name: value
props.description: Emits the formatted string.

props.description:

v1.3. `onValueChange` emits both the formatted and raw strings via
`{ value, raw }` and matches every other voidframe form-control's
callback shape.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Fires on every keystroke. Receives `{ value: formatted, raw: unmasked }`
— preferred over `onChange` (which only emits the formatted string).

props.description: Visual size variant — `"sm" | "md" | "lg"`. Default `"md"`.

props.name: wrapperProps
props.description: Props forwarded to the outer wrapper `<div>`.

name: Masonry
description:
CSS-grid-based masonry layout. Configurable column count per breakpoint;
handles mixed-height children.

name: MegaMenu
description:
Wide top-nav dropdown with grouped columns of links. Keyboard-navigable
and responsive.

name: Mention
description:
Rendered mention chip (e.g. `@alice`). Clickable, hoverable, and linkable
to a profile.

name: MentionInput
description:
Text input with `@`-triggered mention autocomplete. Emits structured
tokens on change.

props.name: onMention
props.description: Emits whenever a mention is inserted.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Trigger character. Default "@".

props.name: renderMention
props.description: Formatter for the inserted token. Default: `@label`.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size variant — `"sm" | "md" | "lg"`. Default `"md"`.

props.name: wrapperProps
props.description: Props forwarded to the outer wrapper `<div>`.

Supports items, checkbox/radio items, submenus, separators, and labels.

Top-level menu bar (like a desktop app). Horizontal row of `MenuBarMenu`
entries, each with a dropdown. Ensures only one sibling menu is open at
a time via a shared activeId registry.

name: MenuBarMenu
description:
Single menu entry inside a `MenuBar`. Owns a dropdown activated by click
or keyboard.

name: MenuCheckboxItem
description:
Menu item with a checkbox control. Controllable via `checked` /
`onCheckedChange`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic tone — mirrors `MenuItem.tone`.

name: MenuContent
description: Positioned popover that holds menu items. Subpart of `Menu`.

name: MenuIcon
description:
Menu icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to

styles. Mirrors Button/Badge/AlertV2 tone vocabulary.

surface in a fallback block.

content, actions, timestamp.

props.name: replyTo
props.description: Quoted message this is replying to.

name: MessageActions
description:
Action rail for a chat message (copy / edit / regenerate / react). Visible
on hover, keyboard-accessible.

name: MessageContent
description:
Body slot of a chat `Message` — renders markdown, attachments, code
blocks, and citations. Also accepts arbitrary `children` for streaming +
tool-call composition. `MessageMarkdown` is a named alias for consumers
who prefer explicit naming for the content-rendering role.

citations. Optional when `children` is supplied.

description:

Esc to cancel, Cmd+Enter to save.

name: MessageFeedback

reason? }` on change.

name: MessageGroup
description:
Visually groups consecutive messages from the same author into a single
run.

description:

description:
Brutalist top navigation bar. Slot-based compound layout: `Navbar.Brand`,
`Navbar.Links` (with `Navbar.Link` children), and `Navbar.Actions`.
Pass `sticky` to pin the bar to the top of the viewport.

name: NavGroup
description:
Grouped section of a nav/sidebar with an optional heading. Used inside
`Sidebar` / `Navbar`.

name: NavItem
description:
Single nav/sidebar item: icon, label, optional badge, active state. Wraps
a link.

props.name: badge
props.description: Optional trailing content (badge, count, etc).

props.name: href
props.description: Href: when provided, NavItem renders an <a>; otherwise a <div>.

props.description: Indentation level (multiplies by 14px).
