props.description: Render as a polymorphic element via children (Radix-style asChild).

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic tone — destructive nav entries, warnings, etc.

name: NetworkGraph
description:
Force-directed graph. Nodes relax via d3-force; drag a node to pin it.
Peer: `d3-force`.

props.name: linkDistance
props.description: Per-edge target distance. Default 60.

props.name: chargeStrength
props.description: Charge strength between nodes (negative = repulsion). Default -180.

props.name: centerStrength
props.description: Optional pin centring force strength. Default 0.05.

props.name: directed
props.description: Render arrowheads on edges. Default true.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Click a node to highlight its neighbourhood. Default true.

props.name: rubberBand
props.description: Dragging a node tugs its neighbours via alphaTarget(0.3). Default true.

props.name: coolDownAfter
props.description: Lock the simulation after this long (ms) without a tick. Default 4000.

name: NetworkInspector
description:
DevTools-style network request inspector: list of requests with status,
timing, headers/body on expand.

props.name: showDetail
props.description: Show the request detail pane (bottom) when an item is selected.

name: NotificationBadge
description:
Small numeric or dot badge overlay for a host element (e.g. a bell icon).
Hides at zero by default.

props.name: count
props.description: Number to display in the badge.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum count before showing `{max}+`. Default 99.

props.name: dot
props.description: Show a dot instead of a count.

props.name: showZero
props.description: Show badge even when count is 0. Default false.

props.name: offset
props.description: Pixel offset from default corner position as [x, y].

props.name: color
props.description: Override badge color (sets `--vf-accent` on the indicator).

props.name: size
props.description: Badge indicator size.

name: NotificationCenter
description:
Drawer of grouped notifications with read/unread state, per-item actions,
and clear-all.

props.name: accent
props.description:
Accent color (hex / CSS color). Themes the unread badge + the
unread-row highlight. Defaults to `--vf-danger` so consumers who
don't override get a neutral theme-aligned red badge.

props.name: anchor
props.description:
Force the dropdown anchor side. Defaults to `"start"` which opens
below-and-right of the trigger.

name: NumberDisplay
description:
Locale-aware number formatter via `Intl.NumberFormat`. Takes `value` and
optional precision / notation.

props.name: signed
props.description: Show sign for positive numbers too.

name: NumberInput
description:
Numeric text input with min/max/step, keyboard increment/decrement, and
locale parsing.

Accessibility / test ergonomics: rest-spread props (including `data-testid`
and `aria-*`) are forwarded to the inner native `<input type="number">` so
`getByTestId(id)` returns the actual control and `.value` reads work. Use
`wrapperProps` for attributes that genuinely belong on the outer div.

props.name: size
props.description:
Voidframe-native size variant. Mirrors Input/Textarea/Select so forms
read consistently at any density. Applied to the inner `<input>` via the
`.vf-input--{size}` class pattern.

props.name: defaultBlank
props.description:
When true, the uncontrolled default is `""` (empty) instead of `min ?? 0`.
Use for forms where "no entry yet" should remain distinguishable from
`0` until the user types.

props.name: wrapperProps
props.description:
Props to apply to the outer wrapper `<div>`. Use this when a consumer
needs to attach a `data-*` attribute or ref to the container rather
than the inner numeric `<input>`. Rest-spread (`{...props}`) lands on
the native `<input>` element so `data-testid`, `aria-*`, and any other
HTMLAttributes are forwarded to the control as consumers expect.

name: NumberStepper
description:
Numeric input with +/- buttons. Thinner than `NumberInput` for table cells
and toolbars.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment/decrement amount. Default: 1.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Custom display formatter, e.g. `(v) => "$" + v`.

props.name: hideInput
props.description: Show value as text only (no editable input).

name: OfflineBanner
description:
Top-of-page banner that appears when `navigator.onLine` flips to false.
Auto-hides on reconnect.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Allow dismissing while still offline. Reappears on next disconnect.

name: OHLCChart
description: Alias — OHLC is the tick-style variant.

props.name: variant
props.description: `"candle"` (default) draws filled bodies, `"ohlc"` draws tick marks.

props.name: xTicks
props.description:
Preferred tick count on the x axis. Note: the candle chart renders its
x axis on a band scale; band scales emit one tick per category, so this
value is ignored when the chart has category-typed input. Kept for
future compatibility with linear/time x scales.

props.name: upColor
props.description: Up tone (close > open). Default `var(--vf-green)`.

props.name: downColor
props.description: Down tone (close < open). Default `var(--vf-red)`.

name: OrganizationCard
description:
Org identity card: logo, name, tagline, and a metric row. Companion to
`UserCard` / `TeamCard`.

name: OrgChart
description:
Top-down hierarchical chart (e.g. org structure). Collapsible subtrees and
pan/zoom.

name: PageHeader
description:
Page-title block for top-of-page sections. Renders a `title` (h1) with
optional `eyebrow`, `description`, `breadcrumbs`, `actions`, and a
trailing `tabs` slot. All slots accept any ReactNode.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Optional eyebrow/overline text.

name: Pagination
description:
Offset-based page picker with numbered buttons plus optional prev/next
and first/last chevrons. Controlled via `value` + `onValueChange(page)`.
Tune the visible range with `siblingCount` and `boundaryCount`; toggle
a rows-per-page `<select>` with `showPageSize`.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: How many page buttons to show on either side of the current page. Default 1.

props.name: boundaryCount
props.description: Always-shown page count at each end (first and last). Default 1.

name: Palette
description:
Displays a palette (array of colours) with optional labels and
copy-on-click.

name: ParallelCoordinates
description:
Parallel-coordinates chart for high-dimensional data. One vertical axis
per dimension; polylines connect a record's values.

props.name: strokeOpacity
props.description: Per-row opacity. Default 0.55.

name: PasswordInput
description: Password field with show/hide toggle and optional strength meter.

props.description: Raw event handler — kept for backward compatibility. Prefer `onValueChange`.

props.description: Value-emit handler — matches the convention used by every other voidframe form component.

props.description: Show/hide toggle button. Default true.

props.description: Start with password revealed.

props.description:
Value to render. By default interpreted as already in percent units

description:
Lightweight confirmation popover anchored to a trigger. Cheaper than a
full modal for simple yes/no prompts.

props.description:
Attributes applied to the built-in Confirm button. Defaults:
`data-testid="vf-popconfirm-confirm-button"` — override to disambiguate
multiple concurrent popconfirms in tests, or to attach an extra
`aria-*` hook.

`data-testid="vf-popconfirm-cancel-button"`.

description:
V1 popover anchored to a `trigger` with click- or hover-activation and
a fixed `position` (top/right/bottom/left).

name: PopoverV2
description:
Compound anchored popover. Compose `PopoverV2.Trigger` and
`PopoverV2.Content`; content is portaled to the body and positioned
with viewport-flip and edge-clamp. Wraps a `DismissableLayer` (click
outside / Escape) and, when `modal`, a focus trap. Controlled via

name: Portal
description:
Render children into a detached DOM node. Returns `null` until mount so
SSR matches the client HTML.

props.name: container
props.description: Target container. Defaults to `document.body`.

props.name: inheritTheme
props.description:
When true, the portaled subtree is wrapped in a `<ThemeScope>` mirroring
the nearest ancestor's resolved theme. Defaults to `true` so portaled
overlays (Dialog, DrawerV2, Menu, ContextMenu, Tooltip, Popover, Toaster,

- the consumer ran `<VoidframeProvider scope="root">` (no documentElement

- a nested `<ThemeScope themeName="…">` overrode theme for a subtree
  that contains the portal trigger.

Set to `false` for portaled content that needs to render outside the
voidframe theme cascade (very rare — e.g. embedding a third-party widget
with its own theming).

description:
Keep a child mounted long enough to play its CSS exit animation.

The child is expected to:
1. Read its `data-state` attribute (`"open"` or `"closed"`) for CSS targeting.
2. Define `animation` / `transition` for each state.

Presence watches `animationend` / `transitionend` on the child, so ensure
the exit rule sets a real animation or transition — otherwise the child
unmounts synchronously.

props.name: present
props.description: When false, the child unmounts *after* finishing its CSS exit animation.

name: PresenceList
description: List of online users with presence state and optional typing indicator.

name: PrintButton
description:
Button that invokes `window.print()` with optional before/after hooks for
transient styling.

Caveat: when a `target` ref is provided, the subtree is serialized via
`outerHTML` into a hidden iframe. Serialization is lossy — canvas bitmaps,
hydrated event listeners, shadow DOM contents, and `<input>` values not
reflected in attributes will not round-trip. For pixel-perfect prints of
dynamic content, take a screenshot via `html2canvas` (or similar) first.

name: PrintLayout
description:
Print-optimised layout wrapper that suppresses nav chrome and tightens
typography when `@media print` is active.

name: Progress
description:
Linear progress bar. Determinate (`value`) or indeterminate. Tones mirror
status palette.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description:
When true, forces the indeterminate (no-value, continuously-animating)
state regardless of `value` / `variant`. Explicit form of the older
`variant="indeterminate"`; the variant prop still works for backward
compat, but `indeterminate` is clearer when the state is driven by a
boolean condition ("loading" / "pending").

name: PromptTemplateEditor
description:
Editor for an LLM prompt template: body textarea plus a sidebar of named
variables.

name: PromptTemplateList
description: List of saved prompt templates with preview, rename, duplicate, delete.

description:
Renders a scannable QR code SVG from a string.

Requires the optional peer dependency `qrcode-generator` to produce
real output. When the peer is missing OR still loading, the
component renders a clearly-labelled placeholder. Bypass both by
passing a pre-computed `matrix` prop.

props.name: matrix
props.description:
Provide a pre-computed NxN boolean matrix to bypass both the

`data-*` hooks. Rest-spread (`{...props}`) lands on the inner native
`<input type="range">` so `data-testid`/`aria-*` forward to the control.

name: Slot
description:

- Exactly one child element required (dev-warns otherwise).
- Event handlers compose: parent's fires after child's.
- `style` and `className` merge (child wins on conflict for `style`,
  className strings concatenate).
- `ref` is merged with the child's existing ref.

name: SmallMultiples

Grid of small charts sharing encoding / scale. Good for comparing many
categories at once.

props.name: columns
props.description: Max columns in the responsive grid. Default auto-fit at min 240px.

props.name: minItemWidth
props.description: Minimum column width when `columns` is not set. Default 240px.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Renderer for each facet. Receives the item + its index.

props.description: Per-facet label placed above each child. Optional.

children to push them apart.

name: Spotlight

description:
Row or grid of `Stat`s with consistent spacing and optional dividers.
Pass `columns` for an N-column grid; omit for the default horizontal row.

props.description:
Render children in a CSS grid with `N` equal columns rather than the
default horizontal flex row. Useful for 3-up / 4-up stat dashboards
that previously forced consumers to wrap in their own grid. Omit or
set to 0 to keep the default row behavior.

name: StatusBar
description:
Bottom status bar (e.g. for an editor / IDE-style UI). Renders items with
icons and text.

name: StatusIndicator
description:
Coloured dot plus label indicating a status (`online`, `idle`, `busy`,
`offline`). Optional pulse.

name: Stepper
description:
Linear step indicator rendered as an `ol` with completed / active /
upcoming states. Dual API: pass a `steps` string array or compose
`Stepper.Step` children (with `label`, `description`, `optional`).

Wrapper that makes its child `position: sticky` with configurable offset
and enabled breakpoints.

props.name: top
props.description: Offset from the top edge. Number = pixels, string = CSS value.

Chat action button that halts an in-progress stream. Shows as a stop glyph
while streaming.

description:

category flow over time.

Formatter for the hovered x tick. When omitted, Date-typed values fall
back to `Date.prototype.toDateString()` (e.g. "Tue Jan 02 2024") and
number/string values are stringified. Provide `xFormat` for locale- or
time-aware display (see `Intl.DateTimeFormat`).

name: StreamingText
description:
Incrementally-rendered text block for streaming LLM output. Shows a
trailing cursor while active.

props.name: speed
props.description: `"instant"` mirrors server tokens verbatim; a number is chars-per-second.

name: Stretch
description: Inline filler for flex containers.

name: SubmitButton

Form submit button with integrated pending state, driven by the nearest
form's submission state.

when a chip is activated.

name: Sunburst
description: Radial hierarchical chart (zoomable). Peer: `d3-hierarchy`.

props.name: labelMinAngle
props.description: Minimum sweep angle (radians) for a label to render. Default 0.25.

swipe-direction events.

props.description: Pixels of travel before a swipe registers. Default 50.

name: SwipeActions
description: List-item wrapper revealing actions on horizontal swipe (iOS Mail style).

props.name: actionWidth
props.description: Width of the action panel that gets revealed. Default 80.

name: Switch
description:
Two-state switch control with a visible on/off label option. Controllable
via `checked` / `onCheckedChange`; keyboard Space / Enter toggles.

props.name: accent
props.description: Active color (sets `--vf-accent`).

props.name: asAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible-name escape hatch — mirrors Input/Textarea.

props.description: Internal escape hatch for voidframe-composed parents.

name: SystemPromptEditor
description: Editor for an LLM system-prompt. Textarea plus saved-preset selector.

name: TabBar
description:
Mobile-style bottom tab bar. Horizontal row of icon+label tabs, each
linked to a route.

name: Table
Tabs
description:
Keyboard-navigable tablist. Arrow keys cycle within the list, Home/End
jump to first/last, Tab leaves the list. Controllable via `active` /
`onChange`; uncontrolled via `defaultActive`.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color for the active trigger (sets `--vf-accent`).

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Keep panel mounted when inactive (preserves state). Default false.

description:
Small removable label chip with optional leading icon. Emits `onRemove`
when the dismiss button is clicked.

props.name: color
props.description: Sets `--vf-accent`.

name: TagInput
description:
Text input that collects tags on Enter/comma. Emits the current array of
tags on change.

props.name: delimiters
props.description: KeyboardEvent.key values that commit the typed text as a tag.

props.name: dedupe
props.description: Reject duplicate entries (case-insensitive). Default true.

props.name: maxTags
props.description: Cap on how many tags may be present.

props.name: validate
props.description: Return `true` to accept, `false` (or a string) to reject. Strings surface as dev warnings.

props.name: inputProps
props.description:
Props forwarded to the inner text `<input>` that drafts new tags. Use for
`data-testid`, `aria-*`, or other attributes consumers want on the
actual text entry field.

name: TeamCard
description:
Team identity card: avatar group, name, member count, CTA. Companion to
`UserCard` / `OrganizationCard`.

name: Terminal
description:
Interactive terminal emulator surface. Emits user input lines; host app
supplies output.

Terminal icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to

description:
Generic text element. Size, color, transform are CSS-driven; `color`,
`weight`, and `spacing` come through as inline-style overrides because they
are arbitrary per-instance values. Supports polymorphic `as` for choosing
an intrinsic tag, or `asChild` to merge styling onto a consumer-provided
element (e.g. a router link).

props.name: color
props.description: Override text color.

props.name: upper
props.description: Uppercase transform.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render through `<Slot>` and merge props onto a single child element.

name: Textarea
description: A multi-line text field for longer free-form input, with configurable rows and optional label.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Raw event handler — kept for backward compatibility. Prefer `onValueChange`.

props.description: Value-emit handler — matches the convention used by every other voidframe form component.

props.name: size
props.description: Voidframe-native size variant. Mirrors Input.size.

props.name: asAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible-name escape hatch.

props.name: suppressA11yWarning
props.description: Internal escape hatch for voidframe-composed parents.

name: ThemeScope
description:
Subtree-level theme override. Wrap any subtree to apply a different theme
without rerooting the whole app.

props.name: inline
props.description: Render as a span to avoid creating a block-level wrapper.

props.name: globalize
props.description:
When true, theme attributes are also mirrored to `document.documentElement`
for the lifetime of this scope. Use inside a portaled overlay when you
need nested theming to affect the whole page (rare). Defaults to `false`
— nested scopes are local-only.

name: ThemeSelector
description:
Dropdown / segmented control for picking the active theme. Pairs with
`useThemePersistence`.

name: ThinkingIndicator
description: Animated `thinking...` indicator used while an LLM response is pending.

props.name: duration
props.description: Elapsed time in ms, displayed as "thought for Xs".

name: Ticker
description:
Auto-advancing horizontal ticker for news-style headlines. Respects
`prefers-reduced-motion`.

props.name: duration
props.description: Animation duration in ms. Default 800.

props.name: steps
props.description:
Emit exactly N evenly-spaced discrete values between `from` and `to`
instead of smoothly interpolating. Useful when the ticker should hit
specific round numbers. When 0 or unset, the smooth easing path runs.

name: TileGridMap
description:
Built-in US-states layout (postal code keys). Source: standard
"tile grid" arrangement used by FiveThirtyEight / Bloomberg.

name: Timeline
description:
Vertical timeline with dotted axis and event cards. Each item has time,
title, optional body.

props.name: events
props.description: Legacy events array. Compound `<Timeline.Item>` children are preferred.

name: TimePicker
description:
Time-only picker (hours/minutes/optional seconds). Controllable via
`value` / `onChange`.

props.name: value
props.description: Canonical 24h string "HH:mm" or "HH:mm:ss".

props.name: format
props.description: 12h view displays AM/PM toggle; value remains 24h.

props.name: step
props.description: Granularity of minute steps (e.g. 5, 15). Default 1.

props.name: min
props.description: "HH:mm" inclusive lower bound.

props.name: max
props.description: "HH:mm" inclusive upper bound.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size variant — `"sm" | "md" | "lg"`. Default `"md"`.

props.name: wrapperProps
props.description: Props forwarded to the outer wrapper `<div>`.

name: TimeZoneSelect
description:
Dropdown for selecting an IANA time zone. Groups by region and shows
current UTC offset.

props.name: showOffset
props.description: Show UTC offset next to each name.

name: Toast
description:
Transient popup notification for async feedback. For 1.0+ use the
module-level `toast` API (`toast.success`, `toast.info`, `toast.warning`,
`toast.danger`, `toast.promise`) with a `Toaster` mounted near the app
root.

name: Toaster
description:
A portaled queue of transient notifications rendered at a configurable viewport corner.
Mount once near the application root; dispatch toasts via the `toast` API or `useToast` hook.

props.name: renderToast
props.description: Render override per-entry.

name: Toggle
description:
Binary on/off switch with WAI-ARIA `role="switch"` and
controlled/uncontrolled duality. Pass `checked` + `onValueChange(next)` or
`defaultChecked`. Space and Enter toggle; `readOnly` suppresses
changes. Requires `label`, `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: accent
props.description: Active color (sets `--vf-accent`).

props.name: asAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible-name escape hatch — mirrors Input/Textarea.

props.name: suppressA11yWarning
props.description: Internal escape hatch for voidframe-composed parents.

name: ToggleGroup
description:
Group of mutually-exclusive (`type="single"`) or multi-select
(`type="multiple"`) toggle buttons. Controllable via `value` /
`onValueChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual style. `"destructive"` is a parity alias for shadcn migrations —
it cascades to `tone="danger"` so a single prop expresses intent.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Semantic tone. Mirrors Button/Badge/Menu.Item. Emits `data-tone` on
the group root + cascades to `vf-toggle-group--${tone}` BEM class for
CSS targeting.

props.name: allowEmpty
props.description: When false, prevents deselecting the last active toggle. Default: true.

name: TokenCounter
description:
Live token counter for a text input / prompt. Pluggable tokenizer; shows
remaining budget against a configured limit.

name: TokenVisualizer
description:
Visualises tokenisation of a string: each token rendered as a chip with
index and id.

name: Toolbar
description:
Horizontal (or vertical) action strip with WAI-ARIA `role="toolbar"`.
Compose with `Toolbar.Button`, `Toolbar.Link`, `Toolbar.Separator`, and
`Toolbar.ToggleGroup` + `Toolbar.ToggleItem` for single/multi press state.
`aria-orientation` tracks the `orientation` prop. Arrow keys move focus
between child controls; Home/End jump to first/last.

name: ToolCall
description:
Chat transcript block representing a single tool invocation: name,
arguments, result, status.

name: ToolCallGroup
description:
Groups consecutive `ToolCall`s from the same turn with a collapsed
summary.

name: Tooltip
description:
Compact labelling overlay. Wraps a single child and shows `content`
on hover or focus with a configurable `openDelay` / `closeDelay`.
Wires `aria-describedby` by default, or `aria-label` when
`asAriaLabel` is set and `content` is a string. Inherits shared timing
from a surrounding `TooltipProvider`.

props.name: asAriaLabel
props.description: Override aria pattern. Default infers from focusability.

name: TooltipProvider
description:
Groups `Tooltip` instances to share timing. Once one tooltip closes,
hovering another within `skipDelayDuration` (ms) opens instantly
instead of re-incurring `delayDuration`. Place near the root of the
app (or a sub-tree of related controls).

name: TraceViewer
description:
Developer trace viewer for agent runs — flamegraph-style timeline of
parent/child spans positioned by start time and duration.

name: Transfer
description:
Two-list transfer component. Users move items between `source` and
`target` with keyboard / button controls.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected keys.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled: selected keys (items in the right panel).

props.name: titles
props.description: Panel titles — `[left, right]`.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show search inputs inside each panel.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the entire component.

props.name: itemAttributes
props.description:
Return arbitrary HTML attributes for each rendered item across both
panels. Mirrors `Table.rowAttributes` — attach `data-testid` per item.

name: Transition
description:
High-level enter/exit animation wrapper. Composes `<Presence>` with a
predefined animation type.

The child element receives a merged `className` and `data-state`:
- `data-state="open"`  when entering / entered
- `data-state="closed"` when exiting / exited

CSS rules in `@/css/components/transition.css` target those states per
animation type. For custom animations, use `<Presence>` directly and
write your own CSS.

props.name: show
props.description: Show the child. When false, the child unmounts after its exit animation completes.

props.name: type
props.description: Named animation. Maps to `.vf-transition--*` CSS rules.

props.name: duration
props.description: Override both enter and exit duration (ms).

props.name: enterDuration
props.description: Override enter duration only (ms).

props.name: exitDuration
props.description: Override exit duration only (ms).

Hierarchical navigation tree. Expand/collapse nodes with keyboard;

Select dropdown whose options are organised as a tree (cascader-like but

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initially-expanded node values.

props.name: selectableBranches
props.description: If true, clicking a parent selects it; otherwise only expands.

description:

sorting/filtering with hierarchical grouping.

Return arbitrary HTML attributes for each rendered row. Mirrors
`Table.rowAttributes` / `DataGrid.rowAttributes`.

name: TreeView
description:
Tree view. Memoized at the export site so parent re-renders with
referentially-stable `nodes` / `expanded` skip the recursive walk.

props.name: itemAttributes
props.description:
Return arbitrary HTML attributes for each rendered tree node. Mirrors
`Table.rowAttributes` — tests can attach `data-testid` per node without
injecting marker spans inside `renderItem`.

name: TrendIndicator
description:
Up/down / flat arrow plus percentage showing a delta. Tones follow
direction (success on rise, danger on fall, with invertable semantics).

props.name: format
props.description: "percent" or "number". Default "percent".

props.name: showArrow
props.description: Show the ▲/▼ arrow. Default true.

name: Typewriter
description:
Types out a string character by character. Respects
`prefers-reduced-motion` (renders immediately).

props.name: speed
props.description: Typing speed in characters per second. Default 20.

props.name: loop
props.description: Loop the animation by clearing + retyping.

props.name: loopDelay
props.description: Pause at end before looping (ms).

props.name: onComplete
props.description:
Fires every time the full string finishes typing. When `loop` is true
this fires per cycle (once before each clear + retype), not just the
first completion. Callers that only want the first completion should
gate inside the handler (e.g. a `useRef` sentinel).

name: VoidframeProvider
description:
Theme provider. Wraps your app (or a subtree) and injects:
  - `.vf-root` baseline class
  - `data-vf-theme` for stylesheet-driven theme switching
  - `data-vf-density`, `data-vf-contrast`, `data-vf-motion` for modes
  - `dir` for RTL
  - CSS custom properties on `style` when `theme` supplies runtime
    overrides

props.name: theme
props.description:
Full token set or partial overrides merged over `defaultTokens`.
For pure theme switching, prefer `themeName`.

props.name: themeName
props.description:
Named theme. `"system"` follows `prefers-color-scheme`. Custom strings
are emitted as `data-vf-theme="…"` so consumer CSS can register new
palettes statically.

props.name: density
props.description: Density mode. Scales spacing globally.

props.name: contrast
props.description: Contrast mode. Boosts text + border tokens under `"high"`.

props.name: direction
props.description: Writing direction. Root gains `dir="…"`.

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description:
Motion behavior. `"auto"` (default) respects OS preference; `"always"`
force-disables motion; `"never"` overrides the OS preference and
keeps animations on.

props.name: cssBaseline
props.description: Inject the optional CSS reset (`.vf-baseline`).

props.name: locale
props.description:
Full locale pack (messages + direction + firstDayOfWeek). When
supplied, direction auto-derives from the pack unless the
`direction` prop above overrides it.

props.name: messages
props.description: Partial message overrides layered on top of `locale` (or English).

props.name: localeTag
props.description: Override the BCP-47 locale tag independent of the locale pack.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Derived from locale pack when omitted.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: Default time zone for date/time rendering.

props.name: scope
props.description:
Where theme attributes get written. Default `"global"` writes to
`document.documentElement` so portaled overlays inherit the theme.
Pass `"root"` to restrict theme scoping to the provider's wrapper div.

name: VoidframeReactFlowTheme

stylesheet. Place at any level above `<ReactFlow>`.
